subfigures.description: One combined ray diagram, no separate subpanels. Concave arcuate mirror near the right, short diagonal hatching on its right/back. Object upright on the left, smaller image downward near the middle. No given numerical measurements.

items.pixels: Solid horizontal line crosses object base B, O, image base B_1, F, and mirror pole P, continuing to the right margin. Left-to-right order B, O, B_1, F, P.
Thick upward arrow from B on the principal axis to A above it on the left. A label above/left, B below the axis.
Short downward arrow from B_1 on the axis to A_1 below it. A_1 is where the reflected paths meet. B_1 label is above/left of the short vertical arrow, A_1 below/right of the crossing.

Solid diagonal descending-right from A, through O on the axis and A_1 below, to the lowest labeled mirror point. Opposing filled arrows on this same straight track indicate travel toward the mirror and retracing toward A. The lower mirror label reads C with a detached short slanted stroke at its upper right, recorded here as C'. The stroke is separate from the C body and above its baseline.

A descending-right solid ray from A through F reaches the mirror at K below P. Direction toward the mirror is marked by a filled arrow. From K a nearly horizontal reflected track points left, passes A_1, and extends well left of the image. K label is below/left of its mirror contact.

A shallow descending-right solid ray from A meets mirror pole P on the axis. Its reflected line descends to the left, passes A_1 and continues beyond. Filled arrows point toward P on incidence and away from P on reflection.

Solid horizontal line from A to mirror E above P has a rightward filled arrow. E label above/left of its contact. The reflected line from E slopes down-left through F and A_1 and extends beyond A_1, with a filled arrow pointing down-left.
Mirror contact labels from top to bottom: E, P, K, C'. The curved mirror extends above E and below the bottom contact. Its back-side hatch marks lie to the right.
A, B, O, B_1, A_1, F, E, P, K, C' are present. No explicit focal-plane or secondary-axis label/line in this figure. No numbered ray badges or numeric givens.

textPixelDifferenceToResolveInSpec.constraint: Preserve the observed prime in the source mapping, while making the body text C point unambiguous. This is a nomenclature bridge, not permission to change any passed prose or invent an additional mirror contact.

uncertainties: The thick original strokes obscure exact point centroids; no metric coordinates or precise mirror radius are source givens.
Some arrow strokes overlap the ray tracks. Direction was recorded only for visible oriented arrowheads, not inferred from physical laws.
Exact hatch count and scan flecks are not semantic geometry.
notClaimed: No reopening of a source detail strip.
No exact numerical scale or exact nonparaxial convergence inferred from the source image.
